## What's new

- **Clear Drime trash.** The Trash screen has a **Clear Drime trash** button
  that empties your Drime trash in one go. It clears everything there,
  including files you trashed in the Drime app.

## Fixed

- **Deleting a Drime backup took up to 15 minutes.** Deleting the backup of
  a folder now moves it to your Drime trash, which takes about a second
  however many files it holds, and r2backup then empties it from the trash
  in the background.
